* '''Original''' ([[Moff Gideon]], 12 May 2020): Original: the first Players Committee card image in the Holotable image set (12 May 2020); the set was released 22 March 2020, and no earlier image of the card was found. Players Committee card image, 12 May 2020: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-moffgideon-20200512.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/moffgideon.gif Holotable commit a5142dd “Tweak set images”], no mark). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Rebels here (and at adjacent sites if your E-web blaster here) are power -1. When deployed, may ▼ an E-web blaster or an Imperial stormtrooper for -3 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Moff Gideon (Errata)]], 14 October 2020): Players Committee card image, 14 October 2020: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-moffgideon-20201014.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d5f24d6/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/moffgideon.gif Holotable commit d5f24d6 “oct 2020 errata”], mark “E”). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Rebels here (and at adjacent sites if your E-web blaster here) are power -1. When deployed, may ▼ an E-web blaster (or an Imperial stormtrooper) here for -2 Force.” '''What changed:''' “may ▼ an E-web blaster or an Imperial stormtrooper for -3 Force” became “may ▼ an E-web blaster (or an Imperial stormtrooper) here for -2 Force”; the image is now 357×498 (was 745×1039).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 20 February 2023): Players Committee card image, 20 February 2023: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-moffgideon.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8c98fe0/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/moffgideon.png Holotable commit 8c98fe0 “Set 12 Remastered”], mark “E1”). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Rebels here (and at adjacent sites if your E-web blaster here) are power -1. When deployed, may ▼ an E-web blaster (or an Imperial stormtrooper) here for -2 Force.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 12 remaster: the card was re-rendered at 745×1039 (was 357×498), copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”; same words; the mark is now “E1”. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
